bibl.title: Justice in the Flesh: Constructing Dike as a Dramatic Character in Aeschylus fr. 281a Radt.
bibl.seg: Zoe Stamatopoulou, Justice in the Flesh: Constructing Dike as a Dramatic Character in Aeschylus fr. 281a Radt.
Lucia Athanassaki, Christopher Nappa & Athanassios Vergados (edd.), Gods and Mortals in Greek and Latin Poetry = Ariadne. Supplement. 2 (Rethymnon, 2018) pp. 119-136.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. XX, 2256 (= MP3 46; LDAB 128). - Examines how this fragment constructs Dike as a divine figure and how her portrayal in this play relates to the Hesiodic tradition.
